metadata.name: Appearance Lab
metadata.description: Appearance settings: preview mode, accent swatches, density and a corner radius rotary dial. A live mini inbox window re-lays out with layout animations; accent clicks release a color bloom from the swatch. Outputs the generated CSS variables live; built-in light/dark toggle for the panel itself.
